This dataset is not an official administrative layer from the National authorities but was agreed and endorsed for operational use by IMWG in October 2016

The administrative level 2 boundaries do not conform to the COD-PS.

The boundaries and names shown and the designations used on this map do not imply official endorsement or acceptance by the United Nations.
source.datasetDescription:
Kenya administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 2 levels:  
- Admin 1: 47   
- Admin 2: 290   
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 28 January 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 31 October 2019: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 03 July 2018: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 03 July 2018: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Regional Office for Southern and Eastern Africa (ROSEA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rosea).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
